metadata.title: Reflections on the Prime-Status Corridor with Commander Sol: From Exact Primehood without Order to Cardinality-Induced Arithmetic
metadata.description: A bilingual mathematical preprint introducing the Prime-Status Quotient, a multiplicative quotient preserving exact primality while erasing prime coordinates. The paper develops a definability corridor through finite phase, successor/WMSO structure, recurrence barriers, the finite-carrier arithmetic jump, equinumerosity synchronization, and the transferred Bès cardinality dichotomy.
metadata.notes: Published as Prime-Status Corridor v1.0. The deposited binary files are treated as immutable archival artifacts; repository-side citation and release metadata record the assigned DOI.
